_README: Notary FAQs shown on /notary. Add, edit or reorder items; each needs a q and an a.

notary.q: How much does a notarization cost?
notary.a: North Carolina sets notary fees by law: $10.00 per signature for acknowledgments, jurats, verifications and proofs, and $10.00 per person for an oath or affirmation.

If I come to you, travel is billed at actual mileage at the current federal business mileage rate. You agree to it in writing before the appointment. That's a North Carolina requirement, not a preference. There is no flat travel fee.

notary.q: Should I sign my document before you arrive?
notary.a: No. Bring it unsigned. I have to watch you sign it.

notary.q: What do I need to bring?
notary.a: A valid, unexpired photo ID for every signer, your unsigned document, and everyone who needs to sign, present at the appointment.

notary.q: Can you tell me which form I need, or explain my document?
notary.a: No. A notary cannot choose documents, explain what a document means, or advise whether to sign it. If you need that, you need an attorney, and I'll tell you so.
